decisions.reason: As a bread close to the core assortment, it is cheap to continue offering and there is still no concrete negative signal strong enough to justify abandoning it.
The mill tour remains strategically valuable for the firm's heritage-based experience offer, but its higher dependence on visitor demand and staff capacity gives it the highest near-term exit risk.
This farmhouse bread fits the established bakery range and uses existing capabilities, so the option is still worth keeping unless sales clearly disappoint.
As an award-winning flagship Christmas stollen with strong fit to the firm's identity, it shows positive value and costs little to retain as a seasonal product.
The premium Christmas stollen also has positive quality validation and strong seasonal fit, though it is slightly more exposed to portfolio rationalization than the flagship variant.
